title: Introducing the Arkham (ARKM) Token Sale on Binance Launchpad!
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce the 32nd project on Binance Launchpad -  Arkham(ARKM)  (The  webpage  is estimated to be available in 4 hours). The token sale for Arkham will follow the  Launchpad   subscription format , with the recording of user BNB balances starting at 2023-07-11 00:00 (UTC).  Binance will record user BNB balances for  six days  from 2023-07-11 00:00 (UTC) to 2023-07-17 00:00 (UTC). The final BNB holding amount for each user will be determined as the average of the six days, using the Daily Average BNB Balance calculation previously announced  here . ARKM Token Sale Details:  Token Name: Arkham (ARKM) Launchpad Hard Cap: 2,500,000 USD  Hard Cap Per User: 15,000 USD (300,000 ARKM)  Total Token Supply: 1,000,000,000 ARKM Total Tokens Allocated to Binance Launchpad: 50,000,000 ARKM (5% of Total Token Supply) Public Sale Token Price: 1 ARKM = 0.05 USD (price in BNB will be determined prior to subscription) Token Sale Format: Subscription Supported Sessions: BNB only Subscription Timeline: Preparation Period  2023-07-11 00:00 (UTC) to 2023-07-17 00:00 (UTC): During this period, user BNB balances will be calculated in  hourly snapshots  for each day over a six-day period. Your final average daily BNB balance over these six days will determine the maximum amount of BNB that you can commit later on. Subscription Period  2023-07-17 06:00 (UTC) to 2023-07-18 06:00 (UTC): Subscription will open at this time for all eligible users for a twenty four-hour period. Users must also sign the Token Purchase Agreement at the same time, prior to committing their BNB. Please note that once committed, your BNB will be  locked  and you will not be able to redeem or access any other functions such as transfers, withdrawals or trading until final token distribution.  Calculation Period  2023-07-18 06:00 (UTC) to 2023-07-18 07:00 (UTC): Subscription closes and token allocation calculation begins. Final Token Distribution  2023-07-18 07:00 (UTC): Your final token allocation will be calculated and the corresponding BNB will be deducted from your already-locked BNB amount. Once deducted, your ARKM and BNB tokens will both be transferred to your spot wallet.  To learn more about Arkham (ARKM), read Binance Research's in-depth report   here . Further information:  Launchpad Subscription Format FAQ Launchpad Detailed Allocation Calculation and BNB Deduction Rules Arkham Project Links: Website:  https://www.arkhamintelligence.com   Whitepaper:  https://www.arkhamintelligence.com/whitepaper   Twitter:   https://twitter.com/ArkhamIntel   Discord:  https://discord.gg/arkham Telegram (English):  https://t.me/arkhamintelligence Reminder: Users need to complete their account verification and also be from an eligible jurisdiction to participate in this token sale.  * Users from the following countries or regions will not be able to participate in token sales on the Binance Launchpad platform:  Belarus, Cuba, Crimea Region, Democratic Republic of Congo, Iran, New Zealand, North Korea, South Sudan, Syria, United States of America and its territories (American Samoa, Guam, Puerto Rico, the Northern Mariana Islands, and the U.S. Virgin Islands), Zimbabwe. Thanks for your support! Binance Team 2023-07-10
